goals: Remove the separate Top level drop space.
Use existing tree row edges and horizontal indentation to outdent, including the final visible child bottom edge.
Project drag changes sibling order and parent; Tag drag changes parent only.

pure_boundary.input: source kind/UUIDs, visible occurrence rows with measured bounds, indentation unit and semantic ancestor paths, full snapshot, pointer coordinates
pure_boundary.output: typed action movement / action classification / project movement / tag parent intent or explicit invalid reason
pure_boundary.effects: DOM measures rectangles, maintains stable gesture geometry, displays insertion guide, captures pointer/native events and sends frozen intent through the owner write lane.
pure_boundary.geometry_contract: Measured row/title bounds plus explicit legal-depth stops {depth,x,parent_id,ancestor_id}; stops come from rendered ancestor rows, not inferred catalog membership. Responsive capped indentation may share x stops; choose shallowest matching legal stop and show the exact guide label.

hit_contract: Row center: Action onto Action means Inside; Action onto Project/Tag keeps direct classification semantics.

Catalog center targets accept only same-kind catalog nodes. Edge targets may be mixed Action rows and resolve through their same-kind catalog ancestor path. Project center means child; Project edges mean before/after. Tag center means child; Tag edge uses horizontal depth to choose parent, without promising sibling rank.
For an edge drop, horizontal position selects a legal semantic ancestor depth, independent of capped visual indentation. The insertion guide displays the resulting parent/depth.
Final visible child bottom edge with pointer at root indentation means root append. No new empty region is added.
Action outdent preserves direct Project membership; root before/after across Projects remains invalid. Catalog containment never implies Action membership.
gesture: Freeze measured list geometry and typed source identity at activation; native drag and pointer/touch use the same pure hit resolver.
6px pointer threshold, autoscroll, Escape/cancel, keyboard Move equivalent remain. Shift ranges apply only to Actions and use occurrence keys with UUID dedup.
One completed gesture creates at most one owner operation; relevant structural drift pauses with inline retry.
No drop into self/descendant; hidden rows and collapsed descendants are checked from full snapshot.
recovery: Flush relevant earlier proposals; unknown outcomes gate all writes and retain exact operation ID/arguments.
Newer Action/catalog edits and IME drafts survive gestures and snapshot acknowledgments.
Confirmed own baseline differs from newest external state; external conflicts remain inline, never silently rebased.
verification: Final child -> root end through bottom-left edge, with no Top level element.
Nested Action outdent one level and root, hidden sibling ranks retained; Undo restores original tree.
Project sibling before/after, nested parent, root detach, cycle rejection; durable order verified after fresh read.
Tag parent/root detach with no persisted sibling reordering.
Action center classification still atomic for all selected UUIDs including parent and child.
Trusted native mouse and touch exact destinations, keyboard equivalent, no row layout shift, unknown replay and newer drafts.
Project or Tag dragged to the final Action row bottom edge resolves the corresponding catalog ancestor/outdent/root target; Action center remains invalid for catalog sources.
Collapsed ancestor and capped deep indentation never invent a parent from pixels: legal stop and guide identify actual semantic destination.
Project/Tag drag is a single UUID even when an Action range is selected; catalog controls do not toggle Action selection.

backend_contract.project_move: Existing {id,parent_id} OR strict relative {id,placement:before|after|inside|root,anchor_id?}; direct changed parent appends, unchanged parent is row no-op. Relative destination ranks authoritative in domain.
backend_contract.project_order: Durable nonnegative safe integer via additive migration 0013 default 0; old ties name then UUID; new catalog appends; runtime invalid order is rejected, not defaulted.
backend_contract.undo: Changed destination Project peers share revision/identity markers so later hidden sibling corrections prevent destructive Undo.

outdent_resolution: Action edge at same containment depth -> before/after anchor. Lower depth -> after the semantic ancestor at chosen depth; root-end lower depth -> placement root. Direct classification unchanged.
Project edge at same depth -> before/after; lower depth -> after same-kind ancestor at selected depth; final bottom root depth -> root append.
Tag edge -> parent_id from chosen semantic depth; same-level edge cannot promise reordering.
Catalog presentation depth and Action containment depth are separate. Indentation below a Project/Tag membership header never implicitly reclassifies an Action.
Mixed Action-row edges expose same-kind catalog ancestor paths to catalog sources; the final Action bottom-left can detach Project/Tag to root without an empty target.
